articles.title: Three LLM inflection points in twelve months
articles.excerpt: I gave a keynote at the AI Engineer Code Summit a couple of weeks ago, constructed around the idea that there have been three significant inflection points in the abilities of LLMs and coding agents in the past twelve months. Here's the video of the talk. In this post I'm going to pull out the major inflection point theme and interrogate it more deeply. articles.title: datasette-agent 0.7a1
articles.excerpt: Release: datasette-agent 0.7a1 A small improvement to Datasette Agent: chat sessions could already open an iframe side panel that could then navigate to different pages. This version improves navigation by fragment hashes, for deeper integration with other Datasette plugins that update fragment hashes when the user interacts with the plugin in a way that changes state.
